_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 5 gate halves and seal routines $A0F7-$A376 (the ones not in 49-bank5-screen-objects.json). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: Gate: which half
regions.description: GATE HALVES (slot 5, type `$B5`; entered from `$9F72` and every later frame from `$A0AE`): `$0620,X` non-zero is slot 6, the lock-checker (`$A192`); zero is slot 5, the doors.

regions.name: Gate: slide the doors
regions.description: Slot 5: `$0788,X` non-zero means the lock was released (slot 6 sets it); then, while the offset `$0638,X` is under `$1C`, a counter `$0650,X` counts down and every 8 frames the offset goes up by one: the halves slide apart by up to 28 pixels over about 224 frames.

regions.name: Gate: draw the two halves
regions.description: Two pieces through `$C093` (`$CC34`) with A = `$8B`: y `$84` := `$6F`, x `$85` := `$80` + the offset and `$86` := `$E2`, then x := `$80` - the offset and `$86` := `$22` (`$87` := `$D1` for both): the two doors, placed symmetrically about x `$80`. What `$86` (`$E2` against `$22`) does inside `$CC34` was not read here.

regions.name: Gate: open far enough?
regions.description: The offset under 16 returns: the ship cannot enter before the doors are 16 pixels apart.

regions.name: Gate: is the ship in the doorway?
regions.description: Box 0 of the table `$A327` (x 116-140, y 96-120) is loaded through `$A30E`, `JSR $C0C9` (`$D297`) tests the boxes: carry clear (nothing) returns.

regions.name: Gate: only the ship counts
regions.description: `$6E`, the slot that was hit, must be 0 (the ship); then `$07E8` := 1, and if it already was 1 the routine returns (the push happens once).

regions.name: Gate: push the ship into the corridor
regions.description: Slot 0's fields `$05C0`, `$0608`, `$05F0` := 0 and `$05D8` := `$FD` (a speed of 3 upward); by the ship's x (`$0530`): under `$78` `$05F0` := `$30`, `$88` or over `$0608` := `$FF` and `$05F0` := `$D0` (a sideways nudge toward the middle), else none; `$0668` := `$F8`, then `$A4` := 4: the exit code that means 'into the corridor', acted on by the transition dispatcher.

regions.name: Seal checker (slot 6): the 60-frame delay
regions.description: `$07A0,X` counts down from 60 (set by the init); at zero the check runs at `$A19B`.

regions.name: Seal checker: which corridor
regions.description: `$15` := byte 2 of the record AND `$7F`, minus 1. 10 or more (corridors 11-20 have no lock) goes straight to opening.

regions.name: Seal checker: release the lock
regions.description: `$0787,X` (slot 5's `$0788`) := 1, sound `$3F`, and slot 6 removes itself. This is the signal `$A0FF` waits for.

regions.name: Seal checker: already removed?
regions.description: `$C078` makes the bit mask for `$15` (Y = byte), AND `$04B1,Y`: a set bit goes to the release at `$A1AA`.

regions.name: Seal checker: the lock's own test
regions.description: `JSR $9F10` with A = `$15`: the ten-entry inline table at `$A1C4`; each routine returns without doing anything unless its condition holds, and then ends in `$A245`, which records the seal. The next check sees the bit and releases.

regions.name: Seal 3: stay 20 seconds
regions.description: SEAL (the gate's lock, slot 6 and the conditions; `$15` = corridor - 1 = 0-9; a seal is bit `$15` of `$04B1/$04B2`): `$A2F8` counts seconds in `$0680,X`; 20 or more sets the bit. (`$A1DF` is the RTS, and also seal 4's whole routine: its bit is set from outside by the round creature, `$9FD8`.)

regions.name: Seal 4: nothing here
regions.description: RTS. Its bit is set by `$9FD8` (the move-history test of the shops and message screens).

regions.name: Seal 6: the chip count must change
regions.description: SEAL (the gate's lock, slot 6 and the conditions; `$15` = corridor - 1 = 0-9; a seal is bit `$15` of `$04B1/$04B2`): First call stores `$4C` (the chips, low byte) in `$0680,X`; any later call where `$4C` differs sets the bit. (The player has to spend or collect chips.)

regions.name: Seal 8: press A with no weapon
regions.description: SEAL (the gate's lock, slot 6 and the conditions; `$15` = corridor - 1 = 0-9; a seal is bit `$15` of `$04B1/$04B2`): `$3C` = 0 (no weapon selected) and a new A press (`$F5|$F6` bit 7) sets the bit. `$A201` is the shared RTS.

regions.name: Seal 10: hold B for ten seconds
regions.description: SEAL (the gate's lock, slot 6 and the conditions; `$15` = corridor - 1 = 0-9; a seal is bit `$15` of `$04B1/$04B2`): While B is held (`$F7|$F8` bit 6) `$A2F8` counts seconds; 10 sets the bit. B released clears the counter (`$0680,X` := 0).

regions.name: Seal 7: the move history
regions.description: SEAL (the gate's lock, slot 6 and the conditions; `$15` = corridor - 1 = 0-9; a seal is bit `$15` of `$04B1/$04B2`): `JSR $A2E7` (pairs of the history sum to 8): pass sets the bit.

regions.name: Seals 1, 5 and 9: shoot or touch a box
regions.description: SEAL (the gate's lock, slot 6 and the conditions; `$15` = corridor - 1 = 0-9; a seal is bit `$15` of `$04B1/$04B2`): Y = 0 (box A) from `$A21D`, 4 (box B) from `$A256`: `$A30E` loads the box, `$C0C9` tests it. Seal 9 (`$15` = 8): the ship itself (`$6E` = 0) in the box sets the bit. Otherwise a shot (`$6E` = its slot, 0 means the ship and is ignored) is turned into a type-`$0A` spark, sound `$20`, and `$0680,X` counts the hits: 50 sets the bit.

regions.name: Seal: record it
regions.description: `$C078` (bit `$15` -> mask, Y = byte), `$04B1,Y` OR= the mask. Seals 1-8 live in `$04B1`, 9-10 in `$04B2`.

regions.name: Seal 9: only the ship
regions.description: `$6E` = 0 (the ship) sets the bit; a shot returns.

regions.name: Seal 5: box B
regions.description: Y := 4 and into the box test of seal 1: box B (x 96-143, y 16-56).

regions.name: Seal 2: four zones
regions.description: SEAL (the gate's lock, slot 6 and the conditions; `$15` = corridor - 1 = 0-9; a seal is bit `$15` of `$04B1/$04B2`): Four zones in turn (Y = 0, 4, 8, 12 into the records at `$A2A9`: [bit][box offset][spark x][spark y]). A zone already done (its bit in `$0680,X`) is skipped; otherwise the box is loaded (`$A30E`) and tested; the ship in it (`$6E` = 0) sets the zone's bit and a far call (inline `01 02 80`, bank 1 `$8003`) makes a spark at the zone.

regions.name: Seal 2: sound, next zone, finish
regions.description: Sound `$23`; next record; after the fourth, `$0680,X` = `$0F` (all four) sets the bit. QUIRK recorded in the seal notes: the far call clobbers `$15`, so the completing pass ORs a wrong bit.

regions.name: Seal 2 zones: 4 x [bit][box offset][spark x][spark y]
Second counter
regions.description: `$0668,X` counts frames; at 60 it resets and `$0680,X` (seconds) goes up. Returns the seconds in A.

regions.name: Load a hit box
regions.description: Y selects four bytes of `$A327`: the box [left][right][top][bottom] into `$06E0,X`, `$06F8,X`, `$0710,X`, `$0728,X`, where the collision test `$D297` reads it.

regions.name: Place an object on a cell
regions.description: A = a cell code (high nibble row, low nibble column), Y = the slot. y `$0518,Y` := row x 16 + 8, band `$05F0,Y` := row, x `$0530,Y` := column x 16 + 8; `$C111` (`$FA6B`) turns the pixel position into the PPU address and attribute offset: `$0608,Y` := the attribute offset, `$05C0,Y/$05D8,Y` := the address. Used by both shops to put the items on the floor.
